user.title: Add EcoFlow
user.description: Set up a new hub or load hubs from a saved JSON configuration.

account.title: Choose EcoFlow account
account.description: Which EcoFlow account of the add-on should this hub represent? Add the integration again for further accounts.

manual.title: Name the hub
manual.description: This add-on does not report a list of accounts (older version). The hub then contains all devices. Please enter a display name.

hub.title: Add EcoFlow hub
hub.description:
Connects Home Assistant to the "EcoFlow MQTT Bridge" add-on. The add-on must be running; in the next step you pick one of its EcoFlow accounts. Each account becomes its own hub with its devices.

Tip: turn off "Home Assistant auto-discovery" in the add-on so the sensors are not created twice.

import_json.title: Load configuration from JSON
import_json.description: Paste the previously exported text (export: EcoFlow hub → Configure). Hubs that already exist are skipped; the others are created.

error.bridge_not_found: The add-on does not respond under this base topic. Is "EcoFlow MQTT Bridge" running and using the same MQTT broker?
error.invalid_topic: Invalid base topic (wildcards + and # are not allowed).
error.invalid_format: This is not a valid EcoFlow configuration (expected: export of this integration).
error.nothing_to_import: All hubs in this configuration are already set up.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.
abort.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected.
abort.no_accounts_left: All EcoFlow accounts of this add-on are already set up as hubs.

init.title: Save configuration
init.description: Copy and save this text. Use "Add EcoFlow → Load configuration from JSON" to restore the hubs from it. Changes in the field are not applied.
